critic_corrections.pre: XYZ offers a catalogue of luxury silverware
critic_corrections.post: A curated collection of luxury silverware
critic_corrections.reason: Catalogue->curated is a genuine frame shift (transactional retail register -> artisan/gallery register), not added detail. Reframed is correct.

critic_corrections.post: ice cream cups, coffee cups, cocktail glasses, and bespoke serving pieces
critic_corrections.reason: POST is a proper superset of the PRE item list, retaining both originals and adding new categories. Expanded is correct; Elaborated would apply only if the original items were kept verbatim with descriptors layered on.

critic_corrections.post: premium silver, brass, and other metals
critic_corrections.reason: The underlying category (metallic materials) is intact; POST adds the 'premium' qualifier and names brass explicitly. Same organizing frame, only detail added. Per BC-P001, this is Elaborated, not Reframed.

Minimalism persists but the frame shifts from design-as-style to elegance-as-outcome. Not a scope restriction (Narrowed fails), not mere descriptor layering (Elaborated fails), and the frame genuinely shifts. Reframed is correct.

critic_corrections.post: fusion of functional art and timeless luxury
critic_corrections.reason: Both invoke luxury, but PRE frames it as sensory impression (taste) while POST frames it as artistic-timeless positioning. Narrowed fails: taste is not a specific way of being functional-art-timeless-luxury, and the concept dropped ('taste') is substantive enough that subsumption does not hold. Reframed is correct.

critic_corrections.post: Category: High-end home silverware & interior accessories
critic_corrections.reason: High-end home silverware is a proper subset of home silverware/interior (scope restriction), and POST also expands the category by adding 'interior accessories'. The scope restriction alone satisfies Narrowed.
